name: Nemuro (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nemuro city emblem in red and white: a red disc bearing a white broken ring and stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Nemuro, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 August 1968; the emblem dates from 13 February 1925.

features.role: Nemuro city emblem — a red disc bearing a white broken ring and stylised character
